d: A Civil Planning Engineer develops, monitors, and manages project schedules, resources, and budgets for construction projects, ensuring timely and efficient completion by creating detailed plans, tracking progress against baselines (like MS Project/Primavera), coordinating teams (architects, managers, site crew), managing risks, and reporting to stakeholders, essentially being the mastermind for project execution from blueprints to delivery.
q: Education: Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Management.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in planning software (Primavera P6, MS Project), understanding of construction processes, data analysis.
Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, communication, teamwork, analytical, and leadership abilities.
Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Management.
2 years of UAE experience in Project execution of residential, commercial, or mixed-use building projects.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Project/Primavera, and MS Office Suite.
Strong interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
r: li
Project Planning & Scheduling : Develop comprehensive schedules, set milestones, identify critical paths, and create baseline plans.
li
Progress Monitoring : Track daily/weekly/monthly progress, compare actuals to planned, and prepare reports for management.
li
Resource & Cost Management : Estimate labor/material needs, manage budgets, and forecast cash flows.
li
Coordination & Communication : Liaise with architects, engineers, contractors, and clients; facilitate meetings and document decisions.
li
Risk & Change Management : Identify potential roadblocks, assess risks, and develop recovery plans for delays.
li
Reporting : Prepare progress summaries, highlight weaknesses, and advise on corrective actions.
x: You'll be part of a growing and professional team delivering high-impact infrastructure projects across the UAE. This is your opportunity to play a key role in streamlining procurement and driving project efficiency in a fast-paced contracting environment.
